notes.title: We've released a patch! Here's what's in it!
notes.notes:
[h1]PC fixes now live (All Platforms)
[/h1]

[h2]Advanced Settings Placement
[/h2]
Advanced graphics settings have been moved to the bottom of the list for better visibility.

[h2]Updated Translations (Steam Only)
[/h2]
Improved Chinese translations have been added to the game.

[h2]DLSS and Streamline Updates[/h2]
Fixed crashes when using Windows + D or Alt + Tab.
Resolved crashes occurring when the game is left idle.
Stuttering Improvements (Windows Store / Game Pass)
Addressed stuttering issues during gameplay.

[h2]PlayStation 5 Controller Support
[/h2]DualSense controllers are now supported across all PC platforms.

[h2]Updated Credits[/h2]
The game credits have been updated.
[h2]
Subtitle Fixes[/h2]
Fixed issues where subtitles were missing or lacked drop shadows.
[h2]
Powder and Steel Quest Fixes
[/h2]
Improved visibility for the “Defeat the enemy” quest step.
Added an additional marker for Jung after defeating the revenant.
Fixed an issue preventing progression after defeating Rammuha.

[h2]Resolution Settings
[/h2]
Players can now adjust their resolution in both fullscreen and borderless modes.

Thanks so much for playing!

~ Team Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn

notes.title: Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn finally has a release date, and a demo you can play today
notes.notes:
Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn showed up briefly during the Xbox Showcase to deliver a killer new trailer, and the news fans of A44 have been anticipating for years: a final, actual, honest-to-god release date.

The action RPG arrives July 18, which is a little over one month away.

Read more

notes.title: Prepare for Battle: Flintlock Release Date & Steam Next Fest Demo Announcement
notes.notes:
Your battle begins on July 18th.

The Door to the Great Below has been opened, unleashing the Gods and their armies of the Dead. The lands of Kian are besieged, and the city of Dawn is on the brink of destruction. It’s time for the Coalition army to fight back. Embrace vengeance, gunpowder, and magic as you embark on an epic journey to defeat the Gods, close the door, and retake the world.

[previewyoutube=oIO0Zyx6fZY;full][/previewyoutube]

The Demo comes to Steam for Steam Next Fest from the 10th of June, giving you an early taste of the action before the full game launches!

Step into the boots of Nor Vanek, an elite Coalition warrior, and meet Enki, a mysterious fox-like companion who will guide Nor. Together, you’ll become an unstoppable duo against the Gods.

Traverse the ravaged landscape of Kian, utilizing Enki's magic and portals to soar through the skies while confronting hordes of the undead. Discover new equipment, strengthen your weapons, and upgrade your gear in anticipation of the ultimate showdown against the Gods.

[previewyoutube=d3x4Qi_C3tU;full][/previewyoutube]

Wishlist us to stay updated on our progress and prepare for the full-scale battle when Flintlock launches on July 18th. We are so excited to get the game into your hands. See you very soon!

~ The Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn Team
